title: Restrict Deletion of Entities to Admins and Creators
excerpt: Only admins and creators of issues, cycles, modules, views, and pages can delete them.

title: Rename 'Inbox' to 'Intake' and 'Notifications' to 'Inbox' for Clarity
excerpt: `Inbox` is now `Intake` and `Notifications` is now `Inbox`. Simpler, we think.

title: Restrict Guest Permission for Issue Creation
excerpt: Guests can no longer create issues in projects or edit them. They can continue to create issues in Intake and see them through until they are closed.

title: Deprecate the 'Viewer' Role and Merge into 'Guest' Role
excerpt: Viewers are now gone. Invite folks in as a Guest and toggle ↓ on to let them view all issues.

title: Introduce a 'Favorites' Feature
excerpt: Easily organize and access your favorite pages, projects, views, cycles, and modules under `Your Favourites` on the sidebar on the left.

title: Implement Lossless Edits and Version History for Pages
excerpt: Collaborate on Pages with your team without losing edits. Track changes in Pages with a version history going back 20 edits.

title: Introduce RabbitMQ as a Dependency for Custom Docker Setups
excerpt: ❗❗ IMPORTANT: When upgrading to v0.23, make sure you are using the latest version of Docker Compose. If you are on a custom Docker setup, you'll need to install RabbitMQ and provide the necessary env variables in app-env.

title: Add Text Alignment to Editors

title: Add Callout Feature to Pages Editor
excerpt: Add callouts to your pages with a simple `/callout` command. Create notes, warnings, tips, and more to highlight important information in your documentation.

title: Create a Centralized 'Drafts' Section
excerpt: You will now find a new `Drafts` section in the left navbar where all your drafts across all projects will show up. All under a single tab.

title: Store All User Assets in a Private Bucket
excerpt: All assets on Plane—including attachments, cover images, profile pictures, logos, avatars, and images in issues and page descriptions—will now be stored in a private bucket. This upgrade means enhanced data security, so images uploaded to Plane will only be accessible within the platform.

title: Centralize Workspace Management in a '/god-mode' Interface
excerpt: You asked for it, and we've delivered. Instance administrators can now manage all workspaces directly from `/god-mode`.

title: Implement 'Hyper Mode' for Instantaneous UI Actions

title: Use Field(max_length=...) for Oracle VARCHAR Compatibility

After a lot of searching, I found a solution. This works:

```python
class Hero(SQLModel, table=True):
    id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)
    name: str = Field(max_length=255)
    secret_name: str = Field(max_length=255)
    age: int | None = None
```
